# AUDIO PROFILE: Bima, 27, a laid-off office worker who just opened a tiny street stall, narrating his own comedic business story for a premium animated series.
## SCENE: telling the audience his underdog story with mock-corporate seriousness, as if presenting to a board of directors, then breaking into playful self-mockery.
### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: charismatic, expressive storyteller; confident corporate tone that cracks into deadpan humor; lively pitch variation; amused at punchlines.
Pacing: brisk but clear; short comedic pause before punchlines (marked ...).
Accent: natural casual Jakarta Indonesian (gue/lo), native Indonesian pronunciation, no foreign accent.
